name: ny-residency-leaving-new-york
description: Leaving New York State or New York City, or working remotely for a New York employer from another state, tax year 2026. Covers the domicile factors the Department audits, the statutory resident test (a permanent place of abode plus more than 183 days, any part of a day counts), who carries the burden of proof, the part-year Form IT-203 with its income percentage, special accruals and Form IT-360.1, income from New York work received after the move, the convenience of the employer rule, New York City residence, the audit records that win, a day-count case and a move checklist. Trigger on "moving out of New York", "leaving NYC", "statutory resident", "183 days New York", "IT-203 part-year", "convenience of the employer", "NY domicile audit".
